'''Dunya Ertan''' (DeckTech handle '''Hardpack''') posted seven decklists on DeckTech between February and May 2002. The April–May 2002 lists used the [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|You Can Either Profit By This...]], [[The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One|The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone]] and [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed|Rebel Strike Team]] objectives.<ref name="dt-22997" /><ref name="dt-23051" /><ref name="dt-23127" />
